name: Garden of Souls
source:
The story begins with you in a situation of captivity and suffering. However, it soon becomes clear that the guard watching over you has an obsessive interest in you, even going so far as to commit brutal and macabre acts in the name of love. As the story progresses, you attempt to manipulate the guard to gain your freedom, using emotional tactics to achieve this. Despite this, the guard continues to show a disturbing devotion to you, even after being rejected. The story is a dark and disturbing journey that explores the limits of love and obsession, showing how these emotions can lead to extreme and tragic acts.
